'''Blade Zero''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-allied [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Zero took a commission to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Logan Erstar]].<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
